read_by: kerbfront opus (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium): wall 10: 1 views; wall 1: 4 views; wall 3: 2 views
notes: Upper-floor recesses lowered to match the grid (v about 4.3 and 7.0). The grid roofline sits near 8.3 m while LiDAR gives 9.7 m; total height follows LiDAR. The bays are rounded projecting balconies with solid parapets in front of recessed windows. A utility pole partly hides the right column and the cafe fascia. | The record says 2 storeys, but the photographs show 3 (tiled ground floor plus two floors of bays); the height is set from the LiDAR roof plus the cap. The garage arcade has three doors between tiled piers with dark bases, with a small square window in the pink recess above each door. The unit at 5-11 m is mostly hidden by the bus shelter and its fascia shows no lettering, so it is modelled as a vacant shop. The Café Lé lettering is partly cut off at the corner. The rooftop trellis is set back from the wall and not modelled. | The Chestnut St side is a one-storey garage block, about 4.7 m high, clad in peach vertical board siding with a thin dark cap. It has one wide dark grey overhead garage door with a dark grey frame; the door's position comes from the wall corners in photo 2, as the grid looks shifted. Above 4.7 m the grid shows sky and neighbouring buildings, not this wall. The roofline at 10.4 m follows the main front as instructed (LiDAR roof 9.9 m plus an assumed 0.5 m parapet). There is no shop, signage, awning or window on this wall.
